p: Dudley's High Street is the main shopping street of the capital of the Black Country, and this 18+ MERKUR is right in the middle of town. Dudley has a lot more going for it than its high street, though, and it's well worth sticking around.

Dudley Zoo and Castle, with the castle ruins on the hill overlooking the town, is a short walk from the centre. Just down the road, the Black Country Living Museum is a brilliant open-air museum with old shops, a fairground, trams and fish and chips cooked in beef dripping. You can also take a boat trip into the Dudley Canal Tunnel and limestone caverns. Merry Hill shopping centre is a short hop away by bus.
